instruction: Make me a Spotify playlist called "My Highest Rated Playlist Songs" containing only the highest-rated song from each of my playlists.

steps.code:
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_password = None
for entry in passwords:
    if entry.get("account_name") == "spotify":
        spotify_password = entry.get("password")
        break
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username='ashlee_martinez@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print(login_result)

page_index = 0
library_playlists = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    library_playlists.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

my_playlists = [p for p in library_playlists if p.get("owner", {}).get("email") == "ashlee_martinez@gmail.com"]
print(len(library_playlists), len(my_playlists))
for p in my_playlists:
    print(p["playlist_id"], p["title"], len(p.get("song_ids", [])))

steps.code:
highest_rated_songs = []
for playlist in my_playlists:
    song_ids = playlist.get("song_ids", [])
    songs = []
    for sid in song_ids:
        song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        songs.append(song)
    if songs:
        best = max(songs, key=lambda s: s.get("rating", 0.0))
        highest_rated_songs.append(best)
        print(playlist["title"], "->", best["song_id"], best["title"], best.get("rating"))

created = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title="My Highest Rated Playlist Songs", access_token=spotify_access_token)
print(created)
new_playlist_id = created["playlist_id"]
for song in highest_rated_songs:
    result = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=new_playlist_id, song_id=song["song_id"], access_token=spotify_access_token)
    print(song["song_id"], song["title"], "->", result)
